$comment: Shared test vectors for every byte string that the Go and TypeScript implementations must construct identically.
These cover the canonical bodies and domain-separated messages that anchor signatures are computed over, the AEAD additional authenticated data, and RFC 7638 JWK thumbprints.
A mismatch between the two implementations means signatures produced by the browser will not verify in Go (or vice versa), so both test suites read this file and assert against it:
If a value here changes, the wire format changed, and every already-issued signature over the old bytes stops verifying.
